reason: I do need something better as I add buses, but I'm not moving all my bookings, quotes and driver records onto a brand-new company with zero customers. If it falls over on a Saturday wedding run while I'm behind the wheel, that's my reputation, not theirs.
objection: Coach Manager or my telematics already does half of this for less, and nobody's actually running a fleet on this yet. Switching is weeks of my evenings re-entering data for a product that might not be around in two years.
would_change_my_mind: A free month or two with them loading my existing data for me, plus a couple of other small operators I can ring who are actually using it day to day.
